components: Requests for one limit key arrive at different instances.
Identity and policy scope map every request to shared limiter state.
Atomic counters, token leases, or allocated local budgets track usage.
Each instance admits or rejects using the authoritative allowance.
A network failure chooses fail-open, fail-closed, or bounded local allowance.
